p: Will start at quarterback for the Chargers in Week 12 vs. the Patriots, his first NFL start.
DJ steps in as the starting QB, so he becomes a streaming QB option and the Chargers' pass-catchers and offense are affected.
He's prepared all season long. Like every week was going to be the opportunity.
Uiagalelei would start if Herbert cannot play, with Jake Browning also brought up.
He is a streaming QB option only if Herbert is ruled out.
He would be, he would be the next man up.
